messages:
Maria: Heads-up — onboarding reported confusion around which env vars/flags the CLI vs SDK honor for API keys/org/project. Sample app shows REDWOOD_API_KEY, CLI docs mention REDWOOD_TOKEN. Users get 401s and think keys are broken. Who owns parity + rotation behavior?
Jordan: I hit this locally. SDK currently falls back env->file->metadata but CLI treats REDWOOD_TOKEN differently and has a --project-key flag that bypasses env. Not documented consistently. :thinking_face:
Sam: Oof. We should standardize. Minimal changes: 1) publish canonical env vars, 2) SDK emits warnings when deprecated vars used, 3) ensure sample-apps use the same precedence as CLI so onboarding is deterministic.
Ashley: Quick note about rotation: when a key is rotated server-side we see a mix of 401 vs 403 depending on endpoint. CLI will auto-refresh only for ephemeral/dedicated keys today. Hosted keys need manual rotate. We should add clear UX: a single 401->refresh attempt flow then actionable error.
Maria: Proposal: adopt canonical names REDWOOD_API_KEY, REDWOOD_ORG, REDWOOD_PROJECT. Deprecate REDWOOD_TOKEN with a 6-month warning window. Add telemetry event 'cred_source' so we can see which fallback is surprising people.
Jordan: Proposed precedence (to put in README + SDK):
```
1) CLI flag --api-key / --project-key
2) env REDWOOD_API_KEY
3) env REDWOOD_TOKEN (deprecated)
4) creds file ~/.config/redwood/creds.json
5) metadata server (GCE/GKE/EC2 role)
```
Sam: +1. Also sample-app starter should prefer explicit flags when testing so CI and local runs are consistent (no hidden metadata-based cred pickup).
Ashley: Retry behavior suggestion: on 401 do one automatic refresh if a refresh token is available, otherwise surface a clear error: 'token expired — run `redwood auth login` or set REDWOOD_API_KEY'. Avoid infinite loops and backoff aggressively for 429s.
Maria: Another friction: project-scoped keys used against org admin endpoints produce ambiguous errors. Could we add client-side guard that detects project-key vs org-endpoint and returns a helpful message like 'project key lacks admin scope — try using an org key or a service key'?
Jordan: Example debug help snippet we can add to SDK errors:
```
if (status === 403 && keyLooksLikeProject(key)) {
  throw new Error('403 — project-scoped key. Use org-level key for this endpoint or set REDWOOD_PROJECT to the project you mean.');
}
```
Sam: Implementation notes: small PR to SDK runtime (~150 LOC) + CLI change to unify flag/env parsing. We'll add a --cred-debug flag that prints which source was used (env/file/metadata) but strip PII.
cli-bot: deploy-bot: rolling out CLI v0.19.1 to beta with --cred-debug and cred-source telemetry. Will open canary for devex team. :robot_face:
Maria: Awesome. Can someone file the RFC/issue for deprecating REDWOOD_TOKEN and include migration steps? Also add a short line in the onboarding quickstart to show explicit flags to avoid surprises.
Jordan: I'll open the issue and link PRs for SDK + sample-apps.
Ashley: I'll patch the retry handler and add the actionable 401 message.
Sam: I'll update sample-app and demo scripts to prefer flags.
Maria: Thanks all — let's sync on the PRs tomorrow after the canary runs. :wave:
